// Why Secure Media Tech

Five disciplines.
One accountable team.

Cybersecurity + Infrastructure + Artificial Intelligence + Interactive Technology + Event Intelligence. Hiring four vendors to cover these means four sets of excuses when they collide. We own the whole stack.

Cybersecurity

CEH/CHFI-certified offensive testing, CISSP-track governance, Splunk/QRadar/LogRhythm SOC engineering — not a reseller brochure.

Infrastructure

Cisco routing and switching through BGP/MPLS/QoS depth, VMware/Hyper-V virtualisation, Azure/AWS integration, backup and DR architecture.

Artificial Intelligence

Prompt engineering, AI automation, knowledge systems and agents — always with human-in-the-loop guardrails before publication.

Interactive Technology

Projection mapping, motion-activated installs, laser and kinetic experiences built by the IT Head behind ABRTECH Studio.

Event Intelligence

Live transcription, AI summarisation, delegate portals and broadcast engines forged in six months of EXPO 2020 operations.

// Positioning

What we are NOT

The clearest way to explain SMT is to contrast it with the four vendor types you already meet.

Typical IT Company

"We manage your servers and tickets."

Secure Media Tech

We secure, monitor and automate the estate — then build intelligence products on top of it.

Digital Marketing Agency

"We make things look good."

Secure Media Tech

We make things look good AND pass a penetration test. Every experience ships with segmented networks, hardened endpoints and monitoring.

Event / AV Company

"We deliver the show."

Secure Media Tech

We deliver the show and keep it alive for 180 consecutive days — redundancy, spares rotation and incident playbooks are our baseline, learned at EXPO 2020 Dubai.

Pure Cybersecurity Firm

"We hand you a PDF audit."

Secure Media Tech

We remediate what we find, integrate the fixes into live operations, and understand why an air-gapped server is useless if the pavilion goes dark.

Proof lives in the résumé, not the pitch deck

Zeeshan Haider holds CEH, CHFI, CCNA, MCSA, CompTIA Security+ and CISSP-track credentials with an MS in Cyber Security — and the same hands kept eighteen projection rigs running daily through EXPO 2020 Dubai while serving as Farnek's IT Engineer on site.

  • Security governance today at Business Systems House (Aug 2024–present)
  • Healthcare IT, EHR/PACS/HIS and compliance at QAM Healthcare (2022–2024)
  • IT Head at ABRTECH Studio — "Art Meets Technology" installations since 2021
  • Deployed for RTA, Dubai Airshow, GITEX, Dubai Police ATM stand, Masdar control centre

// Engagement model

  1. 01Assess — threat modelling, infrastructure audit or venue walkthrough within days, not weeks.
  2. 02Architect — one design covering security baseline, network, show-control and data flows.
  3. 03Build — certified engineers and integrators execute; no anonymous subcontractor roulette.
  4. 04Operate — SOC/NOC monitoring, spares discipline and incident playbooks for as long as it matters.
